question: Which mountain-born goddess of hūṃ-form protects the speaker in the center?
premises: Protection is sought in the middle
The speaker asks to be protected
The goddess is Deveśī, of hūṃ-form, and daughter of the mountain
inference: The mountain-born goddess Deveśī, whose form is hūṃ, protects the speaker in the center.
plain_english: May the goddess-lord, whose form is hūṃ and who is the mountain’s daughter, protect me in the middle.
